title.en: Observability: CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, RUM, and Synthetics

sources.title: X-Ray SDK and Daemon Support timeline
supports: The X-Ray SDKs and daemon entered maintenance mode on February 25th, 2026: releases are limited to security issues, with no new features
The page lists no end date for maintenance mode
AWS recommends migrating to OpenTelemetry for instrumenting applications and sending traces to AWS X-Ray
sources.note: The page is about the SDKs and the daemon. It says nothing about the X-Ray service ending; traces are still sent to X-Ray.

sources.title: Migrating from X-Ray instrumentation to OpenTelemetry instrumentation
supports: For Lambda, the options are an auto-instrumentation layer (recommended: AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry; also the AWS managed Lambda layer for ADOT) or a manual setup with a simple span processor, an X-Ray UDP span exporter and an X-Ray Lambda propagator
To use only tracing with the AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry, set OTEL_AWS_APPLICATION_SIGNALS_ENABLED=false
When sent to X-Ray, server spans become segments, other spans become subsegments, and attributes become metadata by default

sources.title: Migrate to OpenTelemetry Node.js
supports: Manual spans in a Lambda function that has the layer are created with @opentelemetry/api, whose version is recommended to match the one the ADOT JavaScript SDK uses

sources.title: AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry: Lambda
supports: The layer is enabled with AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER=/opt/otel-instrument, and its ARN is listed per Region and language
On 2026-10-12 the Node.js ARN for ap-northeast-1 was arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:615299751070:layer:AWSOpenTelemetryDistroJs:16
Supported Node.js runtimes listed: 18.x, 20.x, 22.x. Node.js 24.x is not in the list
By default only the AWS SDK and HTTP instrumentations are enabled; sampling is parent-based and adjustable with OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
Traces are exported through the Lambda embedded agent to X-Ray by default; the older layers that bundle a collector are marked not recommended
The documented CDK setup attaches the managed policy CloudWatchLambdaApplicationSignalsExecutionRolePolicy
sources.note: The ARN and runtime tables are rendered by script. They were read from the page's source, src/config/lambdaLayerArns.js and src/config/supportedRuntimes.js in github.com/aws-otel/aws-otel.github.io (main).

sources.title: Enable your applications on Lambda (Application Signals)
supports: The AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry is also a component of Lambda OpenTelemetry support and provides tracing
Manual steps: add the layer, set AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER=/opt/otel-instrument, attach CloudWatchLambdaApplicationSignalsExecutionRolePolicy, and optionally enable Lambda active tracing

sources.title: Visualize Lambda function invocations using AWS X-Ray
supports: With Active tracing Lambda records two segments per trace for sampled requests; PassThrough only forwards the tracing header
The sampling rate is 1 request per second and 5 percent of additional requests, and it cannot be configured for functions
The execution role needs xray:PutTraceSegments and xray:PutTelemetryRecords
An upstream service's tracing header decides whether Lambda sends a trace

sources.title: Instrumenting Node.js code in AWS Lambda
supports: Lambda's Node.js guide offers ADOT layers or the X-Ray SDK for Node.js to send trace data to X-Ray

sources.title: Log and monitor Node.js Lambda functions
supports: In the text format the Node.js runtime adds a timestamp, the request ID and a log level in front of each line the function logs
With the JSON log format Lambda doesn't double-encode logs that are already JSON encoded
Code that emits embedded metric format with console.log should write to process.stdout instead when the log format is JSON
Log-level filtering needs a level and an RFC 3339 timestamp in the JSON; without a valid timestamp Lambda assigns INFO

sources.title: Configuring JSON and plain text log formats
supports: The default log format for all Lambda runtimes is plain text
The log format applies to both system logs and application logs, and JSON formatting can increase the size of log messages

sources.title: Types of metrics for Lambda functions
supports: Errors counts invocations that end in a function error: exceptions the code throws and those the runtime throws, such as timeouts
Throttled requests count as neither Invocations nor Errors
Duration supports percentile statistics and does not include cold start time
ConcurrentExecutions is read with the Max statistic

sources.title: Monitor CloudWatch metrics for HTTP APIs in API Gateway
supports: HTTP API metrics: 4xx, 5xx, Count, IntegrationLatency, Latency, DataProcessed, sent in one-minute periods
Latency runs from receiving the request to returning the response; IntegrationLatency is the backend part
Route-level metrics need detailed metrics to be enabled

sources.title: Configure logging for HTTP APIs in API Gateway
supports: An HTTP API stage can write access logs to a CloudWatch Logs group in a format built from $context variables

sources.title: DynamoDB metrics and dimensions
supports: ThrottledRequests, SystemErrors, SuccessfulRequestLatency and ConditionalCheckFailedRequests exist as table metrics
SystemErrors counts requests that generate an HTTP 500

sources.title: Configuring how CloudWatch alarms treat missing data
supports: Missing data points can be treated as notBreaching, breaching, ignore or missing; the default is missing
For a metric that reports only when an error occurs, notBreaching is the suggested treatment
When points are missing, CloudWatch evaluates over a wider evaluation range than the evaluation periods

sources.title: Alarm evaluation
supports: Datapoints to Alarm (M) out of Evaluation Periods (N): the breaching points need not be consecutive

sources.title: Using math expressions with CloudWatch metrics
supports: IF(condition, trueValue, falseValue) with a time series compared to a scalar; the result is 0 when the chosen metric has no data point at that time
FILL in an alarm can leave the alarm stuck when the latest minute never has data; an M out of N alarm is the suggested workaround

sources.title: Notifying users on alarm changes
supports: An email subscription to the SNS topic stays pending until the recipient confirms it

sources.title: CloudWatch Logs Insights language query syntax
supports: Commands are separated by the pipe character; fields, filter, stats, sort and limit are commands
Queries are charged by data scanned: select only the needed log groups and the narrowest time range

sources.title: Logs Insights: filter
supports: Conditions are combined with and / or; string values are written in double quotes, as in filter requestId = "1234656"
Field indexes speed up equality filters; filters with like do not use them

sources.title: Logs Insights: stats
supports: stats count(*) by field groups and counts, and an alias is given with as

sources.title: Supported logs and discovered fields
supports: For Lambda logs, fields are discovered automatically only for the first embedded JSON fragment in each log event
Lambda logs get @requestId, @duration, @billedDuration, @maxMemoryUsed, and @xrayTraceId when the line has a trace ID
Field discovery is supported only in the Standard log class

sources.title: Creating metrics from log events using filters
supports: Metric filters are not retroactive: they publish data points only for events after the filter was created
The default value is reported for periods in which logs are ingested and nothing matches; with no logs at all, nothing is reported
A filter with dimensions cannot have a default value, and each distinct dimension value creates another metric
Delivery to the metric is at least once; duplicates may occasionally occur

sources.title: Filter pattern syntax for metric filters
supports: JSON patterns are written in braces with $. property selectors, and combined with && and ||, as in { ($.user.id = 1) && ($.users[0].email = "John.Doe@example.com") }

sources.title: Embedding metrics within logs
supports: Embedded metric format needs logs:PutLogEvents and not cloudwatch:PutMetricData; charges are log ingestion and storage plus the custom metrics generated
A high-cardinality dimension such as requestId creates one custom metric per distinct value
Delivery is at least once; duplicate metric values may occasionally occur

sources.title: Embedded metric format specification
supports: The log event must be a valid JSON object with no additional data at the beginning or end
At most 100 metric definitions per event and 30 dimension keys per dimension set

sources.title: Working with log groups and log streams
supports: By default log data is stored indefinitely; retention is set per log group
Expired log events are not deleted immediately; it can take up to 72 hours

sources.title: AWS X-Ray concepts
supports: Trace data is retained for 30 days
The tracing header is X-Amzn-Trace-Id, with Root, Parent and Sampled fields
By default the first request each second and five percent of additional requests are recorded

sources.title: Sending trace data to AWS X-Ray
supports: X-Ray accepts trace IDs that follow the W3C Trace Context specification, written in X-Ray's format: 4efaaf4d1e8720b39541901950019ee5 becomes 1-4efaaf4d-1e8720b39541901950019ee5

sources.title: Configuring sampling rules
supports: X-Ray sampling is parent-based: the decision is made once by the first service, and downstream services honor it regardless of their own rules
The default is a reservoir of one request per second plus five percent of the rest

sources.title: Amazon SQS and AWS X-Ray
supports: SQS carries the trace header in the AWSTraceHeader message system attribute, which does not count against message size or attribute quotas
With a Lambda consumer, trace context propagation is automatic

sources.title: OTLP Endpoints
supports: Traces can be sent over OTLP/HTTP to https://xray.<region>.amazonaws.com/v1/traces with Signature Version 4

sources.title: Transaction Search
supports: With Transaction Search enabled, spans sent to X-Ray are ingested as logs in the aws/spans log group

sources.title: W3C Trace Context
supports: traceparent is version-traceid-parentid-flags: 2, 32, 16 and 2 lowercase hex characters
Version ff is invalid, and an all-zero trace-id or parent-id is forbidden
The lowest bit of trace-flags is the sampled flag

sources.title: CloudWatch RUM
supports: RUM collects client-side data from real user sessions: page load times, client-side errors and user behavior for web applications
An app monitor generates a snippet for the page, and collects from a chosen percentage of sessions
Data is retained for 30 days; copies can be sent to CloudWatch Logs to keep them longer
With X-Ray active tracing on the app monitor, client page requests appear connected to the services they call

sources.title: Synthetic monitoring (canaries)
supports: Canaries are scripts that run on a schedule, as often as once per minute, and check endpoints even when there is no customer traffic
Canaries create Lambda functions in the account and publish metrics in the CloudWatchSynthetics namespace

sources.title: Amazon CloudWatch Pricing
supports: Free tier: 5 GB of log data (ingestion, storage, and data scanned by Logs Insights), 10 custom metrics, 10 alarm metrics, 3 dashboards of up to 50 metrics, 100 canary runs a month, 100,000 traces recorded and 1,000,000 retrieved or scanned a month
RUM has a one-time free trial of 1 million web RUM events per account, not a monthly allowance
Custom metric charges are prorated by the hour and incurred only when metrics are sent in that hour
A metric alarm is charged for each metric listed in its expression
Each canary run may also incur Lambda, S3, CloudWatch Logs and CloudWatch Metrics charges
RUM pricing example: 20 data events per visit
sources.note: Most prices on the page are filled in by script and were not visible in the fetched HTML; the dashboard price could not be read. https://aws.amazon.com/xray/pricing/ redirects to a CloudWatch page.

sources.title: AWS Price List bulk API: CloudWatch, ap-northeast-1 (metrics, alarms, queries, RUM, Synthetics)
supports: Unit prices for custom metrics, standard alarms, Logs Insights data scanned, RUM events and canary runs in data/pricing/unit-prices.json
USD 0 tiers: 10 metrics, 10 alarms, 5 GB of data scanned, 100 canary runs
No dashboard price appears in the ap-northeast-1 offer file

sources.title: AWS Price List bulk API: X-Ray, ap-northeast-1
supports: Traces stored USD 0.000005 each, traces retrieved or scanned USD 0.0000005 each
USD 0 tiers: 100,000 traces stored and 1,000,000 traces accessed

sources.title: cdkd v0.296.28: src/provisioning/register-providers.ts (CloudWatch, Logs, SNS)
supports: Dedicated providers are registered for AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm, AWS::SNS::Topic, AWS::SNS::Subscription and AWS::Logs::LogGroup
No dedicated provider is registered for AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard, AWS::Logs::MetricFilter, AWS::RUM::AppMonitor or AWS::Synthetics::Canary, so they go through Cloud Control API
sources.note: Also checked in the published tarball's dist. No cdkd command was run against AWS.

sources.title: Resource types that support Cloud Control API
supports: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard, AWS::Logs::MetricFilter, AWS::RUM::AppMonitor and AWS::Synthetics::Canary are listed as supported

sources.title: @opentelemetry/api 1.9.1 and @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node 2.12.0 (npm tarballs)
supports: Without a registered SDK the API returns no-op tracers and spans
A caller's API version is accepted when the registered global has the same major version and an equal or higher minor version; otherwise the caller gets the no-op implementation
NodeTracerProvider.register() installs an AsyncLocalStorage context manager and the W3C trace context propagator
sources.note: Read from build/src/internal/semver.js and the type definitions of the installed packages.

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers Logs
supports: New Workers have observability enabled by default, and JSON logs have their fields extracted and indexed
Retention is at most 7 days; the paid plan includes 20 million log events a month and charges USD 0.60 per additional million
From December 1, 2026, Workers Logs moves to Cloudflare Observability pricing

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers tracing
supports: Tracing is enabled in the Wrangler configuration and instruments Workers without code changes or an SDK; it is in beta
The default head sampling rate is 1 (every request); head_sampling_rate lowers it
Traces are kept for seven days and can be exported to an OpenTelemetry endpoint

definition.ja: 1 行が 1 つの JSON になっているログ。項目の名前で絞り込みや集計ができる。
definition.en: A log whose every line is one JSON object, so it can be filtered and counted by field name.

definition.ja: 時刻ごとの数値の列。リクエスト数、エラー数、応答時間など。CloudWatch では名前、namespace、dimension の組が 1 つのメトリクスになる。
definition.en: A series of numbers over time, such as request counts, error counts or latency. In CloudWatch a name, a namespace and a set of dimensions make one metric.

definition.ja: メトリクスが条件を満たし続けたときに状態を変え、通知などの操作を起こす CloudWatch の仕組み。状態は OK、ALARM、INSUFFICIENT_DATA。
definition.en: The CloudWatch feature that changes state, and triggers actions such as a notification, when a metric keeps meeting a condition. States are OK, ALARM and INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

definition.ja: log group に届くログの行を条件で数え、メトリクスにする CloudWatch Logs の設定。作成より前のログには効かない。
definition.en: A CloudWatch Logs setting that counts incoming log lines matching a pattern and publishes the count as a metric. It does not apply to logs from before it was created.

definition.ja: 決まった形の JSON をログに書くと、CloudWatch がそこからメトリクスを取り出す仕組み。
definition.en: A JSON shape that, written to a log, makes CloudWatch extract metrics from it.

definition.ja: 1 つのリクエストが通った処理の記録。trace ID を共有する span の集まり。
definition.en: The record of the work one request passed through: a set of spans that share a trace ID.

definition.ja: trace の中の 1 区間。名前、開始と終了の時刻、親の span、属性を持つ。X-Ray では segment や subsegment になる。
definition.en: One timed step in a trace, with a name, start and end times, a parent span and attributes. In X-Ray it becomes a segment or a subsegment.

definition.ja: trace、メトリクス、ログの計装と送信のための、ベンダーに依らない仕様とライブラリ。
definition.en: Vendor-neutral specifications and libraries for instrumenting and exporting traces, metrics and logs.

definition.ja: 全部のリクエストではなく、一部だけを trace として記録すること。
definition.en: Recording only a share of requests as traces instead of all of them.

definition.ja: trace ID、呼び出し元の span ID、sampling の決定を次の処理へ渡すための W3C の仕様。HTTP では traceparent ヘッダー。
definition.en: The W3C specification for passing the trace ID, the caller's span ID and the sampling decision to the next process. In HTTP it is the traceparent header.

definition.ja: 実際の利用者のブラウザで、ページの表示時間やエラーを計測して集めること。
definition.en: Measuring page load times and errors in real users' browsers and collecting them.

definition.ja: 決まった間隔で外から API やページを呼び、応答を確かめるスクリプト。利用者がいない時間にも動く。
definition.en: A script that calls an API or page from outside on a schedule and checks the response. It runs even when no user is around.

title.ja: 監視つきノート API: デプロイ済みで呼ばれない月
title.en: Observed notes API: deployed, but never called for a month

ja: リクエストゼロ。ログ、trace、custom metric のデータ点はどれも発生しない
アラーム 2 つが参照するメトリクスは合計 3 つ（5xx の率が Count と 5xx、遅さが Latency）
ダッシュボード 1 つは無料枠（3 つまで、各 50 メトリクスまで）の内と仮定。4 つ目からの単価は確認できていないため、金額に含めていない
API、Lambda、DynamoDB そのものの料金は 04章と 05章の計算のとおりで、ここには含めていない
en: No requests: no log lines, no traces, and no data points for the custom metric
The two alarms refer to three metrics in total (Count and 5xx for the error rate, Latency for slowness)
The one dashboard is assumed to be within the free tier (3 dashboards of up to 50 metrics); the price beyond that could not be confirmed and is not included
The API, Lambda and DynamoDB themselves are priced in chapters 04 and 05 and are not included here

title.ja: 監視つきノート API: 月 100 万リクエストの観測の料金
title.en: Observed notes API: what observing 1,000,000 requests a month costs

ja: 1 リクエストあたりログ 1 KB。アプリの 1 行は実測で 255 バイト（trace の項目つき）、残りは Lambda が書く行で、JSON 形式での大きさは未計測の仮定
ログの保持は 7 日。月平均の保存量を取り込み量の 7/30 と仮定
リクエストが一定の間隔で届くと仮定。毎秒 0.38 件で、Lambda の既定の sampling（毎秒最初の 1 件と残りの 5%）では全件が trace になる。これは上限で、実際の到着が偏れば減る
1 つの trace に含まれる span の数は料金に影響しない（trace 単位の課金）と仮定
trace を画面で開くのは月 10,000 件、Logs Insights で調べるログは月 1 GB
custom metric は NoteConflicts の 1 つ、アラームが参照するメトリクスは 3 つ
ダッシュボードは無料枠の内と仮定。SNS の通知、API・Lambda・DynamoDB そのものの料金は未算入
en: 1 KB of logs per request. The application's line measures 255 bytes with trace fields; the rest is what Lambda writes, whose size in the JSON format is an unmeasured assumption
7-day log retention; average stored volume assumed to be 7/30 of the monthly ingest

Requests assumed to arrive at a steady rate: 0.38 per second, so Lambda's default sampling (the first each second plus 5% of the rest) traces every one. This is the upper bound; uneven arrival lowers it
The number of spans in a trace is assumed not to change the price (charged per trace)
10,000 traces opened a month, and 1 GB of logs scanned by Logs Insights
One custom metric (NoteConflicts) and three metrics referred to by alarms
The dashboard is assumed to be within the free tier. SNS notifications and the API, Lambda and DynamoDB themselves are not included

items.basis: every request traced at 0.38 requests per second

title.ja: ログを 1 行増やす: 月 100 万リクエスト
title.en: One more log line per request: 1,000,000 requests a month

ja: 増やす 1 行はリクエストの行と同じ 167 バイト（実測。trace の項目なし）
保持は 7 日。月平均の保存量を取り込み量の 7/30 と仮定
en: The added line is 167 bytes, the measured size of the request line without trace fields
7-day retention; average stored volume assumed to be 7/30 of the monthly ingest

title.ja: メトリクスを 1 つ増やす

ja: dimension なしの custom metric を 1 つ、毎時間データ点が届く状態で 1 か月
dimension を付けると、値の組み合わせ 1 つごとに 1 メトリクスと数える
en: One custom metric without dimensions, receiving data points every hour for a month
With dimensions, every distinct combination of values counts as one metric

title.ja: Synthetics: 5 分ごとの canary 1 つ

ja: 730 時間 x 毎時 12 回 = 8,760 回の実行
canary が使う Lambda、S3、ログ、メトリクスの料金は未算入
en: 730 hours x 12 runs an hour = 8,760 runs
The Lambda, S3, log and metric charges a canary incurs are not included

title.ja: RUM: 月 1 万回の訪問を全件収集
title.en: RUM: 10,000 visits a month, all collected

ja: 1 回の訪問で 20 イベント（料金ページの計算例と同じ数）、session の収集率 100%
初回の無料トライアル（100 万イベント、1 回限り）は引いていない
en: 20 events per visit (the number in the pricing page's example), 100% of sessions collected
The one-time free trial of 1 million events is not deducted

note.ja: 実際に書かれるログの形と大きさ、ログの query と metric filter の条件を本物のログ行で評価、traceparent と X-Ray の trace ID の変換、span とログの相互参照、属性の許可リスト、sampling されない要求と欠けた span の再現、アラームの条件、料金計算の入力、インフラの assertion
note.en: The shape and size of the lines really written, log queries and the metric filter condition evaluated on real lines, traceparent and X-Ray trace ID conversion, cross-references between spans and log lines, the attribute allow-list, unsampled requests and a lost span reproduced, the alarm conditions, the pricing inputs, and infrastructure assertions

note.ja: 本文の curl を実行。ログの行に traceId が付くこと、span がコンソールに出ること、traceparent を付けた要求が同じ trace ID を引き継ぐこと、TRACE_SAMPLE_RATIO=0 で span が出ずログは残ることを確認
note.en: Ran the curl commands from the chapter: log lines carry a traceId, spans are printed to the console, a request with traceparent continues that trace ID, and with TRACE_SAMPLE_RATIO=0 no span is printed while the log line remains

note.ja: Logs Insights の query の文字列を出力するだけ。AWS には問い合わせない
note.en: Prints the text of a Logs Insights query. Makes no call to AWS

note.ja: 関数を OpenTelemetry の API ごと esbuild で bundle。-c otelLayerArn を付けた場合も synth できることを確認。AWS には問い合わせない
note.en: Bundles the function, the OpenTelemetry API included, with esbuild. Also synthesized with -c otelLayerArn. Makes no call to AWS

records.command: vp run obs:infra:diff / deploy / drift / destroy

note.ja: DynamoDB の table、Lambda、HTTP API、SNS の topic、アラーム 2 つ、ダッシュボード、metric filter を作る。ダッシュボードと metric filter は cdkd が Cloud Control API 経由で扱う
note.en: Creates a DynamoDB table, a Lambda function, an HTTP API, an SNS topic, two alarms, a dashboard and a metric filter. cdkd handles the dashboard and the metric filter through Cloud Control API

note.ja: デプロイ済みの stack が必要。obs:smoke はノートを 1 件作って消す。obs:query は走査したログの量に課金される
note.en: Need the deployed stack. obs:smoke creates and deletes one note. obs:query is billed by the amount of log data scanned

note.ja: AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry を付けた構成。Node.js 24 の runtime はこの layer の対応一覧に無い
note.en: The configuration with the AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry. The Node.js 24 runtime is not in the layer's list of supported runtimes

summary.ja: Lambda の JSON ログ形式で、アプリが console.log に渡した JSON の行が、そのままの形で CloudWatch Logs に入るかを実機で確かめていない。metric filter の JSON pattern と Logs Insights の項目名がこれに依存する。
summary.en: Not checked in AWS: that under Lambda's JSON log format the JSON line the application passes to console.log reaches CloudWatch Logs unchanged. The metric filter's JSON pattern and the field names in the Logs Insights queries depend on it.

resume.ja: vp run obs:infra:deploy、vp run obs:smoke の後、vp run obs:query --name request --id <x-request-id> を実行する。行が見つかり、status などの項目が取れること、NoteConflicts にデータ点が出ることを確かめる。形が違えば、src/compose.ts の出力先を process.stdout に替えるか、query の項目名を直す。
resume.en: After vp run obs:infra:deploy and vp run obs:smoke, run vp run obs:query --name request --id <x-request-id>. Check that the lines are found with fields such as status, and that NoteConflicts gets a data point. If the shape differs, write through process.stdout in src/compose.ts or change the field names in the queries.

summary.ja: AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry を Node.js 24 の関数に付けた構成を動かしていない。ADOT のドキュメントの対応 runtime は Node.js 22 まで。esbuild で bundle した ESM の関数で、手書きの span が layer の SDK に届くか、AWS SDK の自動計装が効くか、実行 role の権限が xray:PutTraceSegments で足りるかも未確認。
summary.en: The configuration with the AWS Lambda Layer for OpenTelemetry on a Node.js 24 function has not been run. The ADOT documentation lists runtimes up to Node.js 22. Also unconfirmed for an ESM function bundled by esbuild: whether hand-written spans reach the layer's SDK, whether the AWS SDK auto-instrumentation takes effect, and whether xray:PutTraceSegments on the execution role is enough.

resume.ja: ADOT のドキュメントの Node.js の表から東京リージョンの layer の ARN を取り、vp run obs:infra:deploy -c otelLayerArn=<ARN> を実行する。vp run obs:smoke の後、X-Ray の画面で notes.* の span が Lambda の segment の下に出るか確かめる。出なければ、関数のログで layer のエラーを探し、runtime を nodejs22.x にして比べる。
resume.en: Take the Tokyo layer ARN from the Node.js table in the ADOT documentation and run vp run obs:infra:deploy -c otelLayerArn=<ARN>. After vp run obs:smoke, check in the X-Ray console that notes.* spans appear under Lambda's segment. If not, look for layer errors in the function's log and compare with the nodejs22.x runtime.

summary.ja: アラームの実際の状態遷移を確かめていない。metric math の IF の式が受け付けられること、リクエストが無い間に 5xx と Count のデータ点が欠損になること、SNS の通知が届くことは、ドキュメントからの読み取り。
summary.en: The alarms' real state changes have not been observed. That the metric math IF expression is accepted, that 5xx and Count have no data points while there are no requests, and that the SNS notification arrives are read from the documentation.

resume.ja: vp run obs:infra:deploy -c alarmEmail=<自分のアドレス> の後、届いた確認メールを承認し、vp run obs:alarms で状態を見る。5xx を起こすには、table の権限を一時的に外す変更を別の branch で deploy するなど、練習用アカウントで行う。
resume.en: After vp run obs:infra:deploy -c alarmEmail=<your address>, confirm the subscription mail and check the states with vp run obs:alarms. To cause 5xx responses, deploy a change that temporarily removes the table permission, from another branch and in a practice account.

summary.ja: cdkd 0.296.28 は AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard と AWS::Logs::MetricFilter を Cloud Control API 経由で扱う。作成、更新、drift の読み戻しが実際に動くかは未確認。
summary.en: cdkd 0.296.28 handles AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard and AWS::Logs::MetricFilter through Cloud Control API. Whether create, update and drift read-back work in practice is unconfirmed.

resume.ja: vp run obs:infra:deploy と vp run obs:infra:drift を実行する。失敗する場合は内容を記録し、著者に判断を仰ぐ（別のツールへは置き換えない）。
resume.en: Run vp run obs:infra:deploy and vp run obs:infra:drift. If they fail, record how and ask the author for a decision; do not substitute another tool.

summary.ja: ダッシュボードの単価（4 つ目から）、Lambda が JSON 形式で書くシステムログの大きさ、layer 経由で送った span が X-Ray の trace として課金されるのかを確認できていない。
summary.en: Not confirmed: the price of a dashboard beyond the third, the size of the system log lines Lambda writes in the JSON format, and whether spans sent through the layer are billed as X-Ray traces.

resume.ja: 料金ページを JavaScript が動くブラウザで開いてダッシュボードの単価を読む。デプロイ後、Logs Insights で 1 リクエストあたりの @message の合計バイト数を測り、data/fragments/19.json の仮定を直す。数日後に Cost Explorer の usage type を見る。
resume.en: Open the pricing page in a browser that runs JavaScript and read the dashboard price. After deploying, measure the total bytes of @message per request with Logs Insights and correct the assumption in data/fragments/19.json. A few days later, look at the usage types in Cost Explorer.
